subject: Bump valkey-py to 6.2.0 for the integration tests (#1695)
reason: The change only updates testing/integration/requirements.txt, bumping the valkey-py test client from 6.0.2 to 6.2.0 for the integration tests. It is a CI/test-dependency change: no module source code, command behaviour, replies, persistence or replication paths are modified, so there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to reach.
